detail: Full summary: OPEN QUESTION, verification in flight and NOT yet answered: does a subagent spawned from a session inherit the parent's Twining store binding rather than resolving from its own working directory? If it does, Twining cannot record correctly for any work spanning two repos, because a subagent dispatched to work in repo B will file its records into repo A's store. A subagent was dispatched with a blocking pre-flight check (compare newest record mtimes and git status in both repos before and after its Gate 1 assemble, and refuse to write if records appear in the wrong store). Do not treat this as confirmed either way until that agent reports.
